description.value: You overload the target creature’s mental and physical faculties with fear, a fear so powerful that even creatures near the original target are affected by the residual energy. When you cast this spell, the target is cowering unless it makes a successful Will save. In addition, all enemies within 20 feet of the target, including the target, are shaken for 1 round.
